operation.summary: Set a link's trust tier on this Bridgit: own (Your Other Devices), associate (Devices of Associates) or public (Devices in the Wild). Narrowing applies at once and removes services the tier doesn't allow; widening a link record needs the other Bridgit to widen too. Also renews an associate's or public link's access. id: a link id, portal:<agent id> or viewing:<device id>; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: access_ms
body.description: associate and public: access from now (renews it)

body.name: review_at
body.description: associate: a review reminder (ms) before the end date; a Portal pairing may have only a review date

body.name: associate_email
body.description: associate: the person's email (required unless already set)
